summary: Active e2e baseline updated with the verified blend-mode design; original review evidence is retained with the main screen.
Same arrangement and spacing. Current capture removes the initial Surface focus ring. Small labels, detached Styles/Nested badges and a weak translucency demonstration remain visible in both.
Current capture moves the Primary check value rightward. Colored full-row fills, text-bracket indicators and a large unused lower panel remain in both captures.
Animated ring is 55% here and 35% in the current capture. This is a captured animation phase, not a regression. Unequal sample-card heights and small legends remain.
Pixel-identical. Swatches dominate a small central panel, with a large empty band above the footer. Current palette presentation findings apply; do not replace colors that are the actual specimen.
Pixel-identical. Narrow chat bubbles, tiny copy and unlabeled wide gutters are the same. Preserve the 380px and 200px cap behavior while improving its explanation.
Current capture removes initial All focus outline. The two-column specimen arrangement remains the same; tiny tab labels and terse 1/2/3 samples remain hard to scan.

Current capture removes Volume focus outline. The same fixed-height scroller clips the next control row and the metadata footer remains small. Keep intentional scroll behavior when revising its presentation.
Pixel-identical. Two top-aligned table examples occupy little of the canvas. Unequal sample widths illustrate explicit tracks and must not be normalized as a supposed alignment defect.
Current capture removes the Settings image-button focus ring. Row layout is unchanged. The Play glyph resembles fast-forward and the click tally is detached from its buttons in both.
Current capture removes the EN focus outline. English, Korean and Japanese examples still use visibly different text scales. Missing focus styling cannot be inferred from the current idle image.
Current capture removes Left Panel focus outline. Same widely separated row and stack examples, small explanatory footer and detached separator lines.
Pixel-identical. Only an unlabeled horizontal triplet numbered 1, 2, 3 is visible near the top-left. Current recommendations concern framing and explanation, not a claim the layout engine failed.
Current capture removes Simple Modal focus outline. Both show the launcher rather than an open dialog. Neither capture establishes the appearance or usability of open and stacked modals.
Current capture removes first left-arrow focus outline. The three blue selector bars and large surrounding margins are unchanged. Current review applies to visible selector composition.

Current capture removes the first back-arrow outline. Selected Page 1, Medium and Blue remain magenta. Disabled-back-arrow and selection recommendations require preserving the different semantic states.
Current capture removes Apple focus outline. Orange is selected independently of Apple focus in the old image. Large empty lower areas within groups remain visible.

Pixel-identical. Left blue cut regions and right inset bounds are operation visualizations. Improvements should label those operations and dimensions without treating different rectangles as a layout error.

Pixel-identical. Four tracks deliberately compare default, accent, explicit-color and no-track styles. Preserve those differences. Small headers and nearly identical repeated row text hinder the comparison.
Current capture removes FlexStart focus outline. The three staggered blocks intentionally demonstrate self alignment. Improve reference guides and labels rather than placing all three on one row.
Pixel-identical. Horizontal and vertical examples share current findings. Blue, green, purple and orange strokes intentionally illustrate customization, not an inconsistent product palette.
Current capture removes Add load focus outline. Both are the stopped, empty state with zero timing statistics and unavailable CPU/RAM. Neither demonstrates live refresh rate or recording performance.
Current capture removes Profile focus outline and leaves the blue selected-tab underline clear. The large profile content well and three small footer actions remain unchanged.
Current capture removes initial Option A focus ring. The old image is useful separate evidence of the yellow-and-white keyboard focus treatment. The four colored choices remain otherwise unchanged.
Pixel-identical. Serif display specimens contrast with handwritten body and caption samples. Current typography-review findings apply without assuming the mixed families are accidental.
Pixel-identical. Red oversized and clipped samples are the subject of the demo. Improvements must target their surrounding explanation and distinguish expected warning examples from real failures.
Pixel-identical. Heading shadow competes with the heading itself, and LIGHT captions sit on the lower panel edge. The 1px to 10px samples deliberately expose strong shadow offsets.
Pixel-identical. The invisible/visible captions beneath the WHITE sample are covered by the tip strip. Chunky 8px and 10px outlines are intentional stroke specimens.
Current capture removes Cozy Kraft focus outline while Ocean Navy remains the active theme in both. P/S/A/D abbreviations and the unlabeled slider remain difficult to interpret.

Current capture removes Notifications focus outline. General switches and Preferences bracket markers deliberately compare two representations. Locked Setting ON still loses its track against the dark disabled row.
Current capture removes top-left focus outline. Both idle views show six triggers and no tooltip. Initial focus absence is not proof that keyboard tooltips fail.
Additional interaction state. The instant trigger is highlighted and a narrow tooltip reads delay 0, shows the moment you arrive. This tooltip is absent from the current idle baseline by design.

additional_findings.observation: The shown tooltip sentence is much smaller than the instant trigger label.
additional_findings.change: Use at least the readable caption size used by the trigger descriptions; verify the full sentence at 1280×720.

additional_findings.observation: The tooltip sentence almost fills its narrow outlined rectangle.
additional_findings.change: Add horizontal and vertical breathing room around the instant-tooltip sentence.

additional_findings.observation: A red outline surrounds a normal informational tooltip.
additional_findings.change: Use a neutral tooltip edge and reserve red for a documented diagnostic or warning state.

additional_findings.observation: The instant tooltip appears immediately below the button without a visible anchor cue.
additional_findings.change: Add a small offset or anchor marker so the tooltip is visually attached to instant rather than a separate control.
